family.physical_binding: physical-volume language requires one independently audited and sealed FD certificate binding the same a_*, v3, and cell map for every sector; no sector-dependent length rescaling

source.parent_derivative: q_x^{ij}(n)=-2 partial H_L[j]/partial j_{ij,x}(-n) at j=0, including the complete native support ledger
source.physical_volume_mode: after the single independently custodied FD binding, Q_vol=Q_aff with no additional factor
source.conjugate_source: j_aff=sqrt(v3/2)*j_cnt, so j_aff:Q_aff=j_cnt:Q_cnt; after binding the same pair is denoted j_vol:Q_vol

ground.allowed: rank(P0)=1 or rho0=P0/rank(P0) fixed prospectively in one exact ground/flux/boundary sector
ground.basis_rule: an individual vector in a degenerate ground space is never load bearing
ground.correlator_rule: all residues and ancestry Grams use the same rho0; for rank one rho0=|0><0|
ground.translation_rule: rho0 is translation invariant so disconnected nonzero-character components vanish

clock.rule: tensor, EM, and matter probes use the same H_L, J6 clock, bound a_* scale, flux/boundary sector, and momentum classes

momenta.representative: lexicographically first minimizer of q(n)=4 sum_i n_i^2-(sum_i n_i)^2 over the integer class
momenta.zero_character: store unprojected homogeneous tensor and scalar/point-group sector data; Pi_TT(0) is undefined and forbidden

cluster.projector: P_C,L([n]) is the sum of complete exact energy-and-quantum-number projectors in the prospectively selected two-polarization cluster
cluster.coalescing_rule: all split members are retained; diameter(Delta_C)/|k| -> 0
cluster.basis_rule: no individual eigenvector inside a degenerate eigenspace is load bearing
cluster.physical_rank: rank P_C=2 after exact sector typing; accidental extra states are included and trigger the extra-mode gate
cluster.raw_numerator: N_raw,AB(C)=sum_s 2*Delta_s*R_raw,AB(s) in the frozen even-Euclidean convention

canonical_source_binding.raw_vertex: Z_Q^raw is the unique positive square root of N_raw on the Frobenius TT image and is always reported
canonical_source_binding.derived_map: a canonical claim requires a same-parent D_L(k) derived and frozen before response inspection; N_can=D N_raw D^dagger and Z_Q^can=sqrt(N_can)
canonical_source_binding.identity_rule: D=I is the raw reporting convention and does not by itself deconvolve a derivative source
canonical_source_binding.pass: an applicable frozen D exists and liminf sigma_min(Z_Q^can)>0 with finite sigma_max on every declared ray
canonical_source_binding.fail: persistent raw rank loss, or canonical rank/lower-bound loss or upper-bound divergence after an applicable frozen D
canonical_source_binding.indeterminate: raw numerator remains full rank but no applicable same-parent canonical D has been derived, whether the raw vertex is nonvanishing or carries a controlled momentum power; this is neither positive G2 nor source-channel refutation
canonical_source_binding.separation_rule: canonical amplitude and normalized ancestry are reported independently; amplitude PASS plus ancestry FAIL gives overall G2 FAIL

ancestry.source_gram: S_AB=Tr[rho0 delta Q_vol,A^TT delta Q_vol,B^TT dagger]
ancestry.cluster_gram: R_AB=Tr[rho0 delta Q_vol,A^TT P_C delta Q_vol,B^TT dagger]
ancestry.normalized_matrix: Omega=S^(-1/2) R S^(-1/2), equivalently generalized eigenvalues R v=eta S v
ancestry.pass: S is positive definite and liminf eta_min>0 on every declared nonzero IR ray
ancestry.fail: S is singular in a required TT direction or eta_min -> 0

representation.poincare: the same pole bundle converges to a unitary massless Poincare representation in the measured common cone with covariant projectors, residues, and amputated vertices
representation.little_group: on the complexified two-state fiber, rotation about k has eigenvalues exp(+2 i theta), exp(-2 i theta), equivalently helicities +2,-2
representation.fail: helicity 0 or +/-1, scalar doublet, noncovariant momentum-dependent TT identification, or absence of the continuum representation
representation.g3_boundary: longitudinal/gauge-null amplitude decoupling and soft universality remain G3

spectral_pass: Delta_alpha,L(k)/|k| -> one finite c_T>0 on all declared nonzero rays
the representation gate proves helicities +2,-2 and rejects a scalar doublet
canonical amplitude outcome is PASS, not INDETERMINATE
the pole is isolated below continuum or protected as an exact delta function at threshold
no negative-norm or additional longitudinal long-range mode
the result is uniform on a frozen neighborhood of admitted inherited higher operators

common_cone.observable: c_hat_X^2=lim ((E_X(k)^2-E_X(0)^2)/J6^2)/(|k|*a_*)^2 for X in {TT, EM, admitted matter probe}
common_cone.pass: one positive isotropic value for every sector and ray using the independently bound common clock and length scale
common_cone.ceiling: equal slopes are not a Poincare or boost-covariance proof

factorization.asymptotic_route: stable isolated helicity-typed states admit LSZ limits with the same Z_Q^can and volume-uniform amputated vertices
factorization.retarded_1pi_route: G^R_QO=Z_Q^can D_C^(-1) Gamma_hO+analytic and D_C (Z_Q^can)^+ G^R has a finite source-independent limit in the same canonical field basis
factorization.pass: at least one route holds for the same projector, clock, source, representation, and IR sequence with a controlled analytic remainder
factorization.ceiling: factorization readiness is not longitudinal decoupling or the G3 soft theorem

required: complete native q_x^{ij}([n]) ledger on every scored G_L
rank-one P0 or fixed rho0 plus exact sector and shared H_L/J6/a_* metadata
full nonzero-k TT correlator or spectral projectors with covariance
all raw classes, three nonzero rays and conjugates, plus separately typed k=0 homogeneous data
cluster gaps, projectors, raw and canonical residue matrices, continuum thresholds and ancestry Grams
Poincare pole-bundle covariance and little-group helicity +/-2 data
matched EM and matter-probe dispersions under the same clock
multipoint data sufficient for one factorization route
independently audited and sealed FD physical cell/scale binding certificate

ceiling: no matched-family pole data, no Poincare/helicity result, no positive G2, no G3 soft theorem, no gravity, and no G
